dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Could you tell me more about Kannazuka?

dialogues.speaker: Miyazaki Saburou
dialogues.text: Kannazuka is disputed territory between the Shogunate and Sangonomiya. Actually, that place belongs neither to the Shogunate who worship the Raiden Shogun, nor to Sangonomiya, who worships Orobaxi.

dialogues.speaker: Miyazaki Saburou
dialogues.text: That's why this place is called Kannazuka, which means "the hill where no gods reside."

dialogues.speaker: Miyazaki Saburou
dialogues.text: At Kannazuka, if you walk past the camp in the east and head southwest, you will find yourself in Tatarasuna.
